reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that visualizes grouped workflow runs in a dedicated tab with live status, progress, sub-agent details, and logs, while also providing tools to start and list workflows.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中按分组展示工作流状态、阶段进度、子 agent 明细和实时日志，并提供创建及列出工作流的工具。
summaries.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that displays grouped workflow status, progress, sub-agent details, and logs while providing tools to create and list workflows.

capabilities: Displays grouped workflow status, stages, sub-agent details, and logs in a web interface
Polls a workflow-groups API for updates every two seconds
Reads persisted workflow run data from local DSH directories
Creates and starts grouped workflows through the workflow engine
Lists current grouped workflow panel data
Persists run-to-group mappings in a local configuration file
